from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-85d8f853.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    for row in out:\n        non_bg = [v for v in row if v != background]\n        if non_bg and len(non_bg) < len(row) and len(set(non_bg)) == 1:\n            for i, value in enumerate(row):\n                if value == background:\n                    row[i] = 1\n    return out\n'''
path.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task85',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
